# Memory Seal — The integrity primitive for agent memory (for AI agents)

Two primitives, both real, both client-side: a 12-rule contamination scanner (injected directives, secrets, contradictions, staleness) and Ed25519-sealed tamper-evident checkpoints that catch any add/remove/edit/reorder since sealing.

Live: https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/cwi-memory-seal/
Operator: Cumulative Web Inc (Agent Deck SKU #38)

## Machine-readable

- `audits`: audits.json
- `checkpoints`: checkpoints.json
- `engine`: memory.js (zero-dep UMD, byte-identical served)
- `schemas`: schema/ (cwi.memory-audit/1.0, cwi.memory-checkpoint/1.0)

## Honest limits

Heuristic triage, not proof. A clean scan is not proof of clean memory. A checkpoint proves integrity since sealing, not truth.

## Use it

Paste MEMORY.md or daily notes and get evidence-bound findings — or seal a checkpoint before context compaction and prove nothing changed since.

Contact: hp@cumulativeweb.com · Source: https://github.com/CumulativeWebInc/cwi-memory-seal
